newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hugo Boss says 96 sales up 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hugo Boss says 96 sales up 10 pct.

text.p: German men's clothing manufacturer Hugo Boss AG said on Monday it had increased its sales by about 10 percent to 990 million marks in 1996.
The company also expects business to develop well in 1997, Hugo Boss said in a statement.

Hugo Boss also said that its chief executive, Peter Littmann, would step down at the end of 1997 when his contract expires. The supervisory board will propose Joachim Vogt, management board member in charge of production and logistics, as his successor, the company said.
